acceptance.given: An isolated timeout-fixture fixture is configured with the timeout/output limit enabled and every non-timeout input held constant.

oracle.expected: The evaluation records an unsuccessful timeout/output-limit termination and the coverage measurement is unchanged from before evaluation.
forbidden: The bounded evaluation succeeds despite the timeout/output limit.
Coverage changes during the unsuccessful bounded evaluation.
The timeout fixture runs with any other input changed.
oracle.observable: The timeout-fixture test records the evaluation termination status/reason and compares pre-evaluation and post-evaluation coverage.

acceptance.then: After the timeout/output limit is reached, the bounded evaluation is unsuccessful and coverage remains unchanged.
acceptance.when: Execute the timeout-fixture through the bounded evaluation entrypoint and inspect its result and coverage during unit verification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated timeout-fixture selector and require an observed unsuccessful timeout/output-limit termination with unchanged coverage; fail if that expected runtime red observation is absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce bounded evaluation timeout/output limits so the isolated timeout fixture terminates unsuccessfully without changing coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema or state changes; reverting this implementation restores the prior bounded-evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Evaluation proceeds under the configured bound, transitions when the timeout/output limit is reached, and terminates unsuccessfully while retaining the original coverage value.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Unit verification observes timeout/output-limit termination marked unsuccessful and exact equality of coverage before and after the isolated fixture run.
